dimensions.name: max_depth
dimensions.meaning: maximum tree depth; values are log-spaced

dimensions.name: max_features
dimensions.meaning: exponent e: each split tries round(n_features ** e) features

dimensions.name: min_samples_leaf
dimensions.meaning: minimum number of samples per leaf

dimensions.name: min_samples_split
dimensions.meaning: minimum number of samples required to split a node; values are log-spaced

beliefs.note: Standard RF sweet spot: moderate depth (8-32) with sqrt-like feature sampling (e ~ 0.5-0.7) balances bias/variance best for general tasks.
Small leaf sizes (3-9) are typically optimal for accuracy on imbalanced data to capture minority patterns without overfitting.
Low split thresholds (3-12) allow the tree to grow deep enough to find complex decision boundaries.

trust.notes: Based on general random forest heuristics for imbalanced classification; specific dataset characteristics (feature count, noise level) could shift the optimum.
